units.source_text: 就是那个时候我发现老师那副蹲着的姿态，

en.t: It was precisely then that I noticed the way the teacher was crouching,

units.source_text: 好像云游僧请求让众弟子人僧堂而遭到拒绝时，

en.t: as if he were a wandering monk who had asked to let all the disciples enter the monks hall and had been refused,

units.source_text: 终日间在大门口，将自己的头垂在自己的行李上生活的所谓"庭诘"的姿势一样。

en.t: like the posture known as "niwazume," in which one spends the whole day at the main gate, living with ones head bowed over ones own luggage.

units.source_text: 如果像老师这样的高僧，模仿新来的云游僧做这样的修行形式，

en.t: If an eminent monk like the teacher imitated a newly arrived wandering monk and took on this form of discipline,

units.source_text: 那么他的谦虚精神就有值得人们震惊的地方。

en.t: then there was something in his spirit of humility that was enough to astonish people.

units.source_text: 可是，我不知道老师是冲着什么才变得如此的谦虚？

en.t: But I did not know what the teacher had directed himself toward in becoming so humble.

units.source_text: 是不是像庭院树下丛生的杂草、林木的叶消、落在蜘蛛网上的露珠对天上的前景表现谦虚那样，

en.t: Was it as if the weeds growing thick beneath the garden trees, the leaves of the woods, and the dew fallen on a spiders web showed humility toward the scene of the sky above,

units.source_text: 老师也对本非自己的本源的恶行和罪孽，

en.t: and the teacher too, toward evil deeds and sins that were not originally his own source,

units.source_text: 以兽类的姿势原原本本地在自己身上映现出来而变得谦虚呢？

en.t: became humble because they were reflected exactly as they were upon his own body in the posture of a beast?
